observations: Heavy consultancy/staffing presence this run: TCS posted 4 near-identical Gen AI/Java reqs, Nagarro 2, Birlasoft 2, Prudent Technologies and Consulting 2, plus EY, UST, NTT, Synechron, Teamware Solutions, Talentgigs, Peoplemint Consultants, SourcingXPress, OrangePeople - all filtered as hard deal-breakers.

'weekday-1' (Weekday recruiting-intermediary platform) posted 8 distinct client roles via freehire this run - not literal mass-posting of one role, but a volume pattern worth flagging; included where stack/level matched, noted as intermediary-sourced.

Fintech product companies were unusually strong this run: Mastercard (3 open reqs), YouTrip (2), Citi (2), JPMorganChase (2), Fiserv, slice, Navi, PayPay India, Drip Capital, PayPal all posted matching SDE-II-band backend roles.

Several exact company+title reposts of jobs already tracked from the 2026-08-29 and 2026-08-31 runs (QuinStreet, Navi, Eltropy, Ecolibrium, Citi Java Developer, JumpCloud, Modulr, Zact, Ecolab) - filtered as duplicates rather than re-presented.
Cross-portal duplicates within this run: Fiserv Specialist SWE and both YouTrip backend roles were found via both linkedin-search and freehire-search for the same posting.
